tables.name: companies
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE companies (
            cik TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            entity_type TEXT,
            sic TEXT,
            sic_description TEXT,
            owner_org TEXT,
            insider_transaction_for_owner_exists INTEGER,
            insider_transaction_for_issuer_exists INTEGER,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            ein TEXT,
            lei TEXT,
            description TEXT,
            website TEXT,
            investor_website TEXT,
            category TEXT,
            fiscal_year_end TEXT,
            state_of_incorporation TEXT,

tables.name: financial_facts
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE financial_facts (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                cik TEXT NOT NULL,
                fact_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                fact_value REAL,
                unit TEXT NOT NULL,
                fact_category TEXT NOT NULL,
                fiscal_year INTEGER,
                fiscal_period TEXT,
                end_date DATE,
                accession_number TEXT,
                form_type TEXT,
                filed_date DATE,
                frame TEXT,
                dimension_segment TEXT,
                dimension_geography TEXT,

                FOREIGN KEY (cik) REFERENCES companies(cik)
            )

field_guide.cik: Company identifier stored as text. Join filings using both CIK and accession number.
field_guide.fact_name: Raw XBRL concept. Related concepts may have different definitions.
field_guide.fact_category: Taxonomy namespace. Compare concepts only under compatible definitions.
field_guide.fact_value: Value in the returned unit. NULL is missing and never implies zero.
field_guide.unit: Original units. USD values are unscaled dollars.
field_guide.end_date: Fact period end. It can precede the filing's fiscal year.
field_guide.fiscal_year: Fiscal-year label of the disclosure. Verify the fact's actual end_date.
field_guide.fiscal_period: Source fiscal-period label. Check period length and frame for flows.
field_guide.frame: Supplementary period indicator. A missing frame does not establish annual duration.
field_guide.filed_date: Submission date, distinct from the fact period end.
field_guide.form_type: Source filing form. One period may be disclosed in several filings.
field_guide.accession_number: SEC submission identifier. A matching filings row may be absent.
field_guide.dimension_segment: Segment scope if supplied. Absence alone does not prove comparability.
field_guide.dimension_geography: Geographic scope if supplied. Absence alone does not prove comparability.

interpretation_notes: Check end_date, fiscal_period, frame and form_type before comparing flows across periods.
Check concept, unit, period length and dimensions before identifying repeats.
Repeated disclosures can reflect revisions. Retain fact IDs and accession numbers and do not sum repeats.
Do not conflate net income, parent-attributable income, operating income and pretax income.

message.content:
Snowflake Inc. (CIK 1640147) emphasizes a set of product and technology initiatives centered on its "AI Data Cloud" platform, as described in its FY2025 annual report (fiscal year ended January 31, 2025; Form 10-K, source `data/filings/1640147/snow-20250131.htm`).

**Overarching strategy.** The company frames its platform as "the innovative technology that powers the AI Data Cloud," enabling customers to consolidate data, apply AI, build data applications, and share data products under a consumption-based model (Item 1, Business; chunk 18053). Its stated growth strategies include "Innovate and advance our platform," with continued significant R&D investment and hiring of technical talent to enable new use cases and strengthen its architectural lead (chunk 31590).

**AI and machine learning.** Snowflake says it is investing significantly in AI Technology, including generative AI, through internal development, acquisitions of companies with complementary AI technology, and partnerships (Item 1A, chunk 80046). Key AI products include Snowflake Cortex AI (LLM functions, Cortex Analyst for structured data, Cortex Search for unstructured data), Document AI for natural-language processing on unstructured data, and Snowflake ML (chunks 38624, 38862, 31590). In 2024 it announced Snowflake Intelligence to let customers create "data agents" for business users (chunk 19975).

**Developer and data-engineering platform.** Snowpark (Java/Scala launched 2021, Python added 2022) and Snowpark Container Services (2023) are highlighted as core to data engineering and AI workloads (chunk 19975). Open-format capabilities such as Iceberg tables and hybrid tables became generally available during FY2025 (chunk 31590).

**Data sharing and monetization.** The Snowflake Marketplace and Internal Marketplace support sharing, acquiring, and monetizing data, applications, and AI products, which the company describes as a growing part of its growth strategy (chunks 254936, 40873).

**FY2025 GA/preview milestones (direct disclosure).** During FY2025, Iceberg tables, hybrid tables, notebooks, Internal Marketplace, Universal Search, Document AI, Snowflake Cortex AI, and Snowflake ML became generally available; lineage visualization, Snowflake Open Catalog, ML Operations, AI model sharing, and model explainability entered public preview and are expected to reach GA in FY2026 (chunk 31590).

**Caveats.** These are management's stated strategies and product-availability disclosures, not evidence of realized financial benefit; the report itself flags risk that AI investments may not deliver anticipated benefits and depends on GPU access (chunk 80046). The FY2024 report (`snow-20240131.htm`) was not separately inspected, so this summary reflects the latest annual filing only.
